record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: Find shift-monotone sequence ideals z(N0) for which the entropy-number ideal LENT_z carries non-vanishing singular traces.

evidence.quote: Problem 18. Find shift-monotone sequence ideals z(N0) such that LENT_z carries non-vanishing singular traces.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{N}_0=\{0,1,2,\dots\}$ and let $\mathbb{R}^{\mathbb{N}_0}$ denote the space of real sequences $a=(a_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}_0}$. A linear subspace $z(\mathbb{N}_0)\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{\mathbb{N}_0}$ equipped with a quasi-norm $\|\cdot\|_z$ is called a shift-monotone sequence ideal if it contains all eventually zero sequences, is complete, and is invariant under the forward and backward shifts $S_+(a_0,a_1,\dots)=(0,a_0,a_1,\dots)$ and $S_-(a_0,a_1,\dots)=(a_1,a_2,\dots)$ with $\|S_\pm a\|_z\le\|a\|_z$ for all $a\in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$, and moreover satisfies the monotonicity condition $|b_n|\le|a_n|$ for all $n$ and $a\in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ implies $b\in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ with $\|b\|_z\le\|a\|_z$.

For Banach spaces $X,Y$ and a bounded linear operator $T:X\to Y$, let $e_n(T)$ denote the $n$-th (dyadic) entropy number of $T$, defined by
$$e_n(T)=\inf\{\varepsilon>0:\ T(B_X)\text{ is covered by }2^{n-1}\text{ closed balls of radius }\varepsilon\text{ in }Y\},\qquad n\ge 1,$$
with $e_0(T)=\|T\|$. Given a shift-monotone sequence ideal $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$, the associated entropy-number operator ideal $\mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{ENT}}_z$ is the class of operators $T$ between arbitrary Banach spaces such that the sequence $(e_n(T))_{n\in\mathbb{N}_0}$ belongs to $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$, equipped with the quasi-norm $\|T\|_{\mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{ENT}}_z}=\|(e_n(T))_n\|_z$.

A trace on a two-sided operator ideal $\mathcal{I}$ (defined on the components $\mathcal{I}(X)$ for each Banach space $X$) is a family of linear functionals $\tau_X:\mathcal{I}(X)\to\mathbb{C}$ that vanishes on commutators, i.e. $\tau_Y(AB)=\tau_X(BA)$ whenever $A:X\to Y$ and $B:Y\to X$ with $AB\in\mathcal{I}(Y)$ (equivalently $BA\in\mathcal{I}(X)$). A trace is called singular if it vanishes on every finite-rank operator.

Problem. Determine all shift-monotone sequence ideals $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ for which the entropy-number ideal $\mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{ENT}}_z$ admits a non-zero singular trace.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open problem in a 2023 survey on traces on operator ideals defined over the class of all Banach spaces. No subsequent work resolving the characterization of shift-monotone sequence ideals z for which the entropy-number ideal carries non-vanishing singular traces was located in the search.
